title: Storefront audit complete: measured backlog and first batch proposal
summary: Completed Production/source reconciliation, mobile and desktop lab baseline, responsive and keyboard review, isolated cart/checkout failure tests and prioritized implementation plan. No storefront source changes or deployment; implementation awaits explicit approval.

changes.detail: Structured audit, ten prioritized findings, P0 release-safety gate, P1/P2/P3 backlog, exact quote-state first-batch proposal, regression strategy and next-account handoff. Added browser screenshots, machine-readable evidence and replayable local harnesses. No application implementation additions, fixes, removals or deployment.

validation.name: Production identity and source reconciliation
validation.detail: READY dpl_CxX8Deg6R6T4prqTnHEiJVvqGu6f, commit ddf12f4a916478f80f1ca75a1ca83a193d36ef28, verified by authenticated read-only provider GET. Editor differences and staging restrictions separated.

validation.name: Performance and responsive audit collection
validation.detail: 24 repeated Playwright lab samples, eight Lighthouse performance runs, eight baseline axe scans and 30 responsive views collected. Findings include slow mobile rendering, narrow hero overflow, hidden/modal focus and contrast issues; passed means evidence collected, not that UX is defect-free.

validation.name: Synthetic commerce checks
validation.detail: 18 existing offline tests passed. Mocked mobile/desktop quantity persistence and quote failures reproduced misleading free-shipping text. Focused check confirmed disabled submit on quote error and stale error after successful recovery. No order/payment submission.

validation.name: Evidence integrity and local history
validation.detail: JSON parsing, referenced local artifacts and scoped Git-status preservation checked by validate.cjs; history check passed with 805 reports before this linked append. Final check recorded separately in artifacts.

validation.name: Untested limitations
validation.detail: Field CWV/INP unavailable: PSI API 429. No physical-device/Safari/screen-reader certification, full transaction/race/idempotency rehearsal, type/lint/build, new deployment or live history preview. No source changes warranting application build.
